specs.Compatible Devices: Car Stereo System, Home Stereo System, Speaker

features: Hi-Res Sound with LDAC codec: This Bluetooth audio receiver is Hi-Res Audio certified to deliver high-fidelity, detailed audio, perfect for music lovers. You can enjoy stunning sound quality with LDAC codec support (24bit/96kHz sampling rate).Convert your old car stereo, wired headphones, or home speakers into Bluetooth-enabled devices via 3.5mm AUX outputs. Enjoy wireless music anytime without replacing your audio system. (To use the LDAC function, make sure your device also supports the LDAC codec.)

Upgraded Bluetooth 6.0 Technology: Equipped with the latest Bluetooth 6.0 chip, the receiver ensures faster pairing, stronger connections, and lower latency—no more easily dropouts during music, calls, or GPS voice navigation.

Hands-Free Calls, Safer Driving: Answer calls with a tap—this Bluetooth receiver features a built-in mic and one-button control for hands-free calling or navigation; no need to look at your phone while driving, making your journey safer. AI noise cancellation blocks background noise so you can hear and be heard clearly, even on the highway.

Support Dual Pairing for Share: This Bluetooth adapter supports connecting two phones at once and switching seamlessly. You can take turns playing music with friends on a road trip or at a party without constantly reconnecting—just pause one device and play from the other. (Note: Only one device can output audio at a time.)

17H Long Battery Life: Say goodbye to battery anxiety—this Bluetooth receiver delivers up to 17 hours of use on a single charge, perfect for commuting, working, or road trips. It supports USB-C charging and can be used while charging, ensuring uninterrupted listening.

Note: *This product is a Bluetooth receiver, not a transmitter. *Supports work with wired speakers, car stereos, and other audio output devices, but doesn't support Bluetooth headsets or other wireless devices.
